protocol.description: The protocol preset name (``"mteb"``, ``"nanobeir"``, ``"plain"``, ...): the comparability label a reader groups rows by.
protocol.title: Protocol

protocol_spec.description: The full scoring convention -- qrel gain (linear/exponential), tie rule, pool restriction, rounding. The ideal DCG follows from the metric and this protocol (qrel-nDCG sorts the query's positive qrels; RCP-nDCG and Count-nDCG sort all of its gains). Two rows with different protocols are never comparable.

revision.description: The source revision: the Hub commit the data was read at, or ``None``.

subset.description: The source subset (mteb's ``hf_subset``); ``"default"`` when the source has none.
